content.content:
Phase 2 scope (see .agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md and .agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md Phase 2):

BACKEND (5 endpoints):
1. GET /api/issues — list with query params (status, assignee, tags, parentId, search). Server-side search filter on title substring.
2. POST /api/issues — create issue. Validate required fields. Return 201 with issue ID.
3. GET /api/issues/:id — view full computed issue.
4. PATCH /api/issues/:id — update issue. Validate at least one field. Map agentrack errors to HTTP.
5. GET /api/users — list users (needed for assignee dropdowns).

FRONTEND:
6. API client layer (api/client.ts, api/issues.ts, api/users.ts with TypeScript types)
7. App layout with React Router (/ and /issues/:id)
8. Issues list page with TanStack Query: IssueList, IssueRow, IssueFilters, StatusBadge, PriorityIndicator
9. Filtering: status dropdown, assignee dropdown, search input
10. Create issue dialog (CreateIssueDialog) with form fields
11. Issue detail page with inline editing for status, priority, assignee, title, description

VALIDATION CRITERIA:
- Issue list loads and displays real data from agentrack
- Can create a new issue via dialog
- Can view issue details at /issues/:id
- Can change status, priority, assignee, title, description
- Filters work (status, assignee, search)
- Navigation between list and detail works

content.content:
Done. Implemented all Phase 2 backend and frontend features:

BACKEND (5 endpoints):
1. GET /api/issues — list with query params (status, assignee, tags, parentId, search). Server-side search filter on title substring.
2. POST /api/issues — create issue with validation. Returns 201 with issue ID.
3. GET /api/issues/:id — view full computed issue details.
4. PATCH /api/issues/:id — update issue. Validates at least one field provided.
5. GET /api/users — list registered users.

FRONTEND:
6. API client layer: api/client.ts (fetch wrapper), api/issues.ts (issue API), api/users.ts (user API) with full TypeScript types.
7. App layout with React Router: routes / (issues list) and /issues/:id (issue detail). TanStack Query provider configured.
8. Issues list page with TanStack Query: IssueList, IssueRow, IssueFilters, StatusBadge, PriorityIndicator components.
9. Filtering: status dropdown (all/open/idea/todo/in-progress/done/closed), assignee dropdown (from registered users), search input (title substring).
10. Create issue dialog (CreateIssueDialog) with title, description, status, assignee, tags, priority fields.
11. Issue detail page with inline editing: click-to-edit title and description, dropdown selectors for status/priority/assignee, navigation back to list.

All endpoints tested and verified working. Build passes with zero TypeScript errors.
